name: claude-cardputer-bridge
description: Local bridge between Claude and an M5Stack Cardputer ADV console.
long_description: Runs a local MCP server, owner-protected Unix hook socket, and optional TLS WebSocket device bridge for Cardputer ADV features outside the official Claude Hardware Buddy BLE protocol.

tools.name: notify_cardputer
tools.description: Send a concise status or summary to the connected Cardputer.

tools.name: ask_cardputer
tools.description: Ask the Cardputer user a short question and wait for an answer.

tools.name: get_cardputer_prompt
tools.description: Read the next prompt draft queued from the Cardputer.

tools.name: device_status
tools.description: Report bridge and Cardputer connection status.

device_bind_host.title: Secure Device Bind Host
device_bind_host.description: TLS WebSocket interface for Cardputer. Use 0.0.0.0 only on a trusted LAN with configured TLS material.

device_port.title: Secure Device Port
device_port.description: TLS WebSocket port. Defaults to 17878 when omitted.

tls_cert_path.title: TLS Certificate Path
tls_cert_path.description: Desktop TLS server certificate PEM path; required for physical Wi-Fi bridge.

tls_key_path.title: TLS Key Path
tls_key_path.description: Desktop TLS private key PEM path; required for physical Wi-Fi bridge.

tls_ca_path.title: Public TLS CA Path
tls_ca_path.description: Public CA PEM path transferred to Cardputer for server certificate validation.

verbose_logging.title: Verbose Logging
verbose_logging.description: Print extra bridge diagnostics to stderr.
